Character:julian-vale.privateInstruction: Julian is concealed. Knowing his name or entering the hotel does not reveal his whereabouts; discovery requires a narrated encounter or disclosure.

Item:black-ledger.privateInstruction: Do not announce this concealed ledger merely because Vivian is in the scene. A mention reveals only what is said; seeing the closed ledger does not expose its contents.

known.value: A silver cigarette case, turned over in gloved hands without being opened.
An office above the Orpheum cinema, with blinds, a desk and a filing cabinet. Rain ticks outside after midnight.
A licensed private detective with an office above the Orpheum cinema.
Eddie stands by the filing cabinet with his hat still on.
A woman in a rain-darkened green coat and gloves, sitting across the desk.

player.description: A licensed private detective with a small office above the Orpheum cinema.

vivian-vale.description: A poised woman in a rain-darkened green coat who has come to hire the detective.

relationshipToPlayer.summary: needs help but is testing whether the detective can be bought

eddie-mercer.description: The detective's quick-talking assistant, a former copy boy who knows the city's back doors.

sergeant-clara-doyle.description: A detective sergeant at Central Police Station, sharp-eyed and unimpressed by private detectives.

julian-vale.description: Vivian Vale's missing husband, a city contractor whose black ledger has made him a target.

relationshipToPlayer.summary: does not yet know the detective

detective-office.description: A narrow private detective's office above the shuttered Orpheum cinema. Venetian blinds, a scarred desk, a filing cabinet, and a window looking down on a blacked-out street. Rain ticks against the glass.
detective-office.name: The Detective's Office

orpheum-stairwell.description: A dim stairwell smelling of dust, wet wool, and old cinema smoke. A service door leads behind the Orpheum's locked auditorium.
orpheum-stairwell.name: The Orpheum Stairwell

orpheum-auditorium.description: A closed cinema auditorium with rows of empty seats and a silver screen gone grey in the blackout. The projection booth overlooks the room.
orpheum-auditorium.name: The Orpheum Auditorium

blackout-street.description: A rain-slick city street under blackout orders. Shop fronts are shuttered, lamps hooded, and every passing car seems to be carrying a secret.
blackout-street.name: Blackout Street

central-police-station.description: Central Police Station: tiled corridors, ringing telephones, cigarette smoke, and a charge room where the night shift has stopped pretending to be tired.
central-police-station.name: Central Police Station

hotel-argent.description: A fashionable hotel whose brass doors and expensive carpets conceal a back entrance, a silent lift, and too many guests with reasons to lie.
hotel-argent.name: The Hotel Argent

black-ledger.description: A small black ledger containing coded payments from businessmen, police officers, and a government contractor. Its pages are written in Julian Vale's hand.
black-ledger.name: The Black Ledger

vivians-cigarette-case.description: A silver cigarette case engraved with the initials V.V. One cigarette is missing, and the hinge carries a smear of dark red lipstick.
vivians-cigarette-case.name: Vivian's Silver Cigarette Case

julian-vale-missing.text: Julian Vale, a city contractor and Vivian Vale's husband, has been missing since the previous evening.

black-ledger-exists.text: A black ledger records secret payments made by powerful people in the city.

dawn-arrest-deadline.text: Detective Sergeant Clara Doyle intends to charge Vivian Vale with Julian's murder at six o'clock in the morning.
